1. Take the luma, extend it with the border mode, and take its FFT.
2. Filter it with log-Gabor filters at every scale and direction.
3. For each direction, measure how well the phases of the scales agree, less the noise threshold.
4. Divide by the summed amplitudes and weight by the spread of the frequencies.
5. Combine the directions into the moments M and m, or into the feature type.
